items.original_title: UK man swims in Strait of Hormuz to highlight environmental damage
items.rss_summary:
A British endurance swimmer who swam in waters in the Strait of Hormuz to highlight the "devastating environmental consequences of war" on Saturday called for the waterway to be reopened and the pollution in it to be cleaned up.  
            "Oil tankers, gas carriers and other merchant ships are being attacked, day after day. The environmental consequences of this war will last for generations," Lewis Pugh wrote in a post on his website.

По его словам, предыдущая гуманитарная операция в Алешках Херсонской области, в ходе которой удалось эвакуировать мирных жителей, стала первым шагом к этому.Также Трамп заявил, что никогда не рассматривал смену власти в Иране как цель политики США. При этом он выступил за бессрочное соглашение с Тегераном, которое исключало бы возможность разработки ядерного оружия.

items.title: Война 1982 года все еще преследует Ближний Восток
items.original_title: The 1982 War Still Haunts the Middle East
items.rss_summary: Journalist and author Kim Ghattas tells Bloomberg This Weekend how the violence that engulfed Lebanon in 1982 helped set the US, Israel, Iran and the wider Middle East on a trajectory that continues to shape conflicts in the region today. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini about her new book, The Best Kind of American, Ghattas examines Hezbollah’s enduring influence, Lebanon’s struggle to assert state authority and the risks of trying to remake the region through war.
